def solve(g,bg):
    cs=comps(g,bg)
    from collections import defaultdict
    T=defaultdict(list)
    for cur,cells in cs:
        T[cur].append(cells)
    out=[c for c,v in T.items() if len(v)>1]
    if not out: return None
    c=min(out,key=lambda c:sum(len(v) for v in T[c]))
    ys=[y for cells in T[c] for y,_ in cells]; xs=[x for cells in T[c] for _,x in cells]
    H=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; W=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
    res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        row=[]
        for j in range(W):
            row.append(c if any((i+min(ys),j+min(xs)) in tc for tc in T[c]) else bg)
        res.append(row)
    return res
